limitations: New C++ interfaces differ from original caller ABI; no game or rendering validation.

Full owned three bodies and original guards execute in isolated relocated PE pages. B24460 has explicit entry ABI bridge to full frozen-library cached-state provider; its captured169-byte body is not executed.

No semantic replacements for synchronization, cached states, D3D9, or Windows critical sections. Observers call actual providers with original driver tables restored, record real HRESULTs, then apply declared callback mutations or C++ exceptions.

All517904 DWORDs compare literally within same-process source/native pairs: complete renderer byte storage, input storage, actual globals and both full CS structures, real getters and sampled x87 status; no pointer normalization. Local stack guard padding is not a cross-interface observable and is not compared.

Only masked x87 exceptions tested. Native EH arm after second FSTP is established by source and whole compiled code audit plus armed/unarmed C++ provider exceptions; no unmasked hardware FP exception equivalence is claimed.

The actual HAL returned success for the selected out-of-range indices, including10000000,FFFFFFFF and14. No failing HRESULT was produced; ignored-result behavior is established by complete code inspection rather than a negative-HRESULT fixture result.
Two cleanup second-exception processes terminate through std::terminate marker ExitProcess73 after real Leave; they never return normally.
No skipped-entry guard is made live by changing disabled mode to enabled.
